Just a test

<div class="sage">
  <script type="text/x-sage">
x,y = var('x,y')
eqs = [x^2-3*x*y==1, y^2-3*x*y==1]
sols = solve(eqs, [x,y])
sols = [tuple([s.rhs() for s in sol]) for sol in sols
    if all(eq.rhs().is_real() for eq in sol)]
sols
  </script>
</div>

<div class="sage">
  <script type="text/x-sage">
p1 = implicit_plot(eqs[0], (-1.6,1.6), (-1.6,1.6))
p2 = implicit_plot(eqs[1], (-1.6,1.6), (-1.6,1.6), color='red')
p1+p2 + point(sols, size=50, color='black')
  </script>
</div>
